title: Stroller and Carrier brand to recommend
label: gear

posts.body:
Hi Mommies!

I need your help as we are about to purchase a baby stroller and carrier next month. We don't own a car so we will commute by bus most of the time. We need a comfortable, strong, light weight stroller and a breathable and sturdy baby carrier. Any brand recommendations? Many thanks in advance.
posts.body_with_quotes:

I need your help as we are about to purchase a baby stroller and carrier next month. We don't own a car so we will commute by bus most of the time. We need a comfortable, strong, light weight stroller and a breathable and sturdy baby carrier. Any brand recommendations? Many thanks in advance.

posts.body: We use the babyzen yoyo. It folds up very compactly and is 5.8kgs. To close it, you need to bend down, but it can be done with one hand still. If you need something that closes without bending down, then I suggest combi wellcomfort. It closes with one hand from the handle, and is also much cheaper than babyzen (but not so compact).

posts.body: U can check out Ricardo easy ride. They have it at Eugene baby. Its compact one hand fold. Cheaper than yoyo.
